chapter_title: Chương 53: Con người và mọi việc đã thay đổi

segments.title: Chương 53: Con người và mọi việc đã thay đổi
segments.content:
When school let out in the afternoon, Zheng Feng ran to the classroom door, waiting to walk with Bian Guanyue.

But Bian Guanyue, carrying her schoolbag, went over to Chen Guiliang's desk. "When is the semifinal?"

Chen Guiliang said, "Mid-January, a little over half a month away. It should be during winter break."

"I hope you win first prize," Bian Guanyue said, making a fist. "Go for it!"

"Thanks," Chen Guiliang smiled.

"Bye."

Bian Guanyue deliberately waved only after she turned away, as if by doing so, she could make it seem that her relationship with Chen Guiliang wasn't that close.

A few of the guys from room 302 gathered around. They had already seen the semifinal invitation letter at noon, but that was with other classmates. Now they wanted to see it again to show an enthusiasm exclusive to roommates.

They escorted Chen Guiliang to the cafeteria, talking about the New Concept Competition as they walked.

"Is there a direct train to Shanghai from here?" Xu Haibo asked.

Li Yulin said, "I don't think so. You'll probably have to transfer in Rongcheng."

Yang Hao said, "My parents go to Rongcheng to transfer every year when they go to work as migrant laborers."

Xie Yang laughed, "Great Hero Chen, don't get on the wrong train. You might wake up and see the Gobi Desert."

"You should buy a few pairs of underwear with pockets and keep all your money in them. My dad says there are a lot of thieves on trains."

"Don't drink beverages from strangers. There might be knockout drugs in them."

"..."

The roommates were all from towns and rural villages. None of them had ever ridden a train, or even left the city.

They longed for the outside world, holding all sorts of fantasies about the unknown distance.

Now that Chen Guiliang was about to embark on a long journey, it was as if he were traveling on their behalf. They nagged him with reminders like a fussy old mother.

After dinner, Chen Guiliang returned to the classroom to work on practice tests.

Tao Xue, estimating the time, strolled over, empty-handed and without an apple.

"Hey, big nephew, I'm here again."

"Hello, Auntie Xue."

Tao Xue sat down in Qin Shanshan's seat, leaning over the desk to watch Chen Guiliang do his problems. She hesitated for two minutes before finally asking, "Do you know what day it is today?"

"What day?" Chen Guiliang really hadn't been paying attention.

Tao Xue teased, "Silly, it's Christmas Eve. You don't even know that."

Only then did Chen Guiliang realize he should be giving Christmas gifts.

Although he had no interest in Christmas.

This holiday was essentially just the winter solstice of ancient Rome, with some discrepancies due to the passage of time. Eventually, it was co-opted and became the birthday of Mr. Jesus.

Chen Guiliang said, "The judges' list for the New Concept Composition Competition will be announced in the early-January issue of Mengya magazine. Pick two of your favorite authors and buy a copy of each of their representative works."

"What for?" Tao Xue asked.

Chen Guiliang said, "A belated Christmas gift. I promised to get you an autograph before, and now I can get you two."

"You made it to the semifinals?" Tao Xue said, pleasantly surprised.

Chen Guiliang took out the semifinal invitation letter. "I received it today."

Tao Xue took the invitation and looked at it over and over, so excited she stood up. "Wow, big nephew, you're amazing!"

"Not a bad Christmas gift, right?" Chen Guiliang asked with a smile.

Tao Xue said happily, "So you do have a conscience."

Girls who loved literature were easy to please.

Tao Xue asked a few more questions about the competition, then went back to her own classroom, delighted.

She took out her phone, wanting to message Bian Guanyue to show off.

But she wrote and deleted the message text over and over, and after several revisions, she finally gave up.

After Tao Xue left, Chen Guiliang also slipped away quickly, heading straight for the stationery and gift shop outside the school.

Bracelets, hair clips, earrings, combs... a lot of things for girls, sparkling and very pretty, but most were just plastic and glass.

Chen Guiliang browsed for a long time but didn't find anything he liked.

Forget it, time is tight. I'll just buy two things.

"This notebook, and this fountain pen, please wrap them in gift paper."

"What kind of gift paper would you like?"

"Something simple."

Chen Guiliang also borrowed a marker from the shop and wrote a terribly cliché phrase on the notebook's flyleaf: Wishing classmate Bian Guanyue a Merry Christmas and happiness every day!

Both gifts were premium items from the store.

The notebook had a leather cover, 5 yuan each.

The fountain pen was a Hero brand, 28 yuan each.

After the evening self-study session ended, the entire campus went a little wild.

It was really just young people fooling around. Christmas Eve and all that was just an excuse to let loose.

It wasn't too out of hand.

Someone was using the tape recorder from the classroom, which was for playing English tapes, to play all sorts of upbeat songs.

Some gathered in groups of three or five, playing and chasing each other on the school plaza.

Others, under the cover of darkness, hid somewhere howling like ghosts, occasionally receiving an answering call, the sounds rising and falling like a pack of wolves passing messages.

The school didn't bother to manage it. The commotion would be over in half an hour anyway.

Releasing some pressure in a timely manner was actually good for the students.

"Bian Guanyue!"

Chen Guiliang called out to Bian Guanyue as she was going downstairs.

"What is it?"

"I wanted to ask, if I go to Shanghai for the competition, which station in Rongcheng should I transfer at?"

"I don't know either. I'll call and ask for you tonight."

The two of them stood there chatting casually, and Zheng Feng became a bit anxious as he waited.

Seeing that almost all their classmates had left, Chen Guiliang finally took out the gift and said, "A day early, happy holidays."

"Thank you!"

Bian Guanyue was overjoyed. "I... I haven't bought you a gift yet. I'll go pick one out at noon tomorrow."

"No need," Chen Guiliang said. "If you really want to give something in return, then after the final exams, come with me to buy a kitten. I promised my grandma I'd get her a cat for company."

Bian Guanyue said, "Then I can get one for my grandpa and grandma too."

Zheng Feng urged from the side, "Bian Guanyue, any later and we'll miss the last bus."

"Bye!" Bian Guanyue waved.

"Bye."

Bian Guanyue put the gift in her schoolbag, her steps becoming even lighter.

Zheng Feng felt extremely miserable. He decided that starting tomorrow, he would stop walking to school with Bian Guanyue.

He used to think he had an advantage, but now Chen Guiliang was becoming more and more handsome, and he was even going to participate in the New Concept Composition Competition.

He was suddenly filled with a sense of inferiority.

The two of them took the bus and got off outside the small alley. Zheng Feng pointed at the streetlamp and said, "It's fixed."

Bian Guanyue said, "Last week, my uncle came home for a visit. He went to the sub-district office, slammed the table, and chewed them out. They fixed the streetlight the next day."

Zheng Feng hesitated again and again, then uttered what he thought were romantic and resolute words: "The streetlight is on now, so I don't need to walk you home anymore. From now on, you have to learn to go home by yourself."

Bian Guanyue: "..."

"Goodbye." Zheng Feng turned around in pain.

Bian Guanyue thought for a moment and called out, "Thank you. I hope you find a better girl!"

In that instant, Zheng Feng's eyes grew moist, as if the world had ended.

It was a pity there were no snowflakes in the dead of winter, otherwise singing a rendition of "A Spray of Plum Blossoms" would have been quite fitting.

When Bian Guanyue got home, she went straight to her bedroom and eagerly tore open the wrapping paper.

A beautiful fountain pen and notebook, along with the well wishes on the flyleaf. The more Bian Guanyue held them, the more she liked them.

She filled the fountain pen with ink and wrote in the brand new notebook:

"December 24, 2003. Overcast."

"It's been two years since I last kept a diary. Today, I'm officially starting again..."

"Grandpa and Grandma are in another world. They would surely want me to be happy. Since transferring schools and changing to a completely new environment, I seem to have become much more cheerful..."

"I've also made a few new friends. Although Wang Siyu is no longer sitting in front of me after we changed seats, she often asks me to hang out on weekends. She's a very free-spirited girl, straightforward and frank, and sometimes she might offend people with her words. But I like this kind of personality, I like her directness..."

"Wu Meng is cold on the outside but warm on the inside, a bit like me. She's my best friend now..."

"Zheng Feng is very annoying sometimes, but he doesn't have any bad intentions... I hope one day, he can find true love..."

"Tao Xue is a little rascal. I know what she's thinking, and I know why she wanted my phone number and QQ. I won't let her have her way..."

"I'm not some delicate queen! I have plenty of strength and tricks up my sleeve!"

"Chen Guiliang... hmm, I'll write about him later. It's time to sleep now."

In the blink of an eye, it was New Year's Day.

There was no day off. The evening self-study session was changed to a New Year's party.

Liu Shuying and Gao Zhan came in person, and the students took turns performing.

Just as they were moving desks to clear space, Tao Chenggang called.

Chen Guiliang walked into the corridor. "Hey, Brother Gang."

Tao Chenggang said, "There hasn't been much noise online about the special campaign by the five ministries today. But the 17577 forum has been shut down. I tried to contact the admin, Can Ying, on QQ, but he hasn't replied. I called his cell phone, and it's a dead number. Do you think he got arrested?"

"If he really got arrested, would he have time to cancel his phone number?" Chen Guiliang laughed. "He must have gotten scared and gone into hiding."

"That's true." Tao Chenggang was also scared, so his thinking ability had declined somewhat.

Chen Guiliang asked, "How's the number of online players for the Abyss private server tonight?"

"Not bad, it's New Year's Day. Over 9,000 people online at the same time. I opened another new server today," Tao Chenggang said.

"It actually increased from before?"

"I've been looking for partnerships with internet cafes. I even drove to the two neighboring cities myself."

"You're doing offline promotions."

"Offline promotions?"

"Yeah, ground-level marketing."

"What else can I do? I don't dare to advertise online anymore, so I have to find ways in the real world. After I'm done with the surrounding cities, I plan to go to the provincial capital."

"That's really tough. Let's drop my cut to 20%."

"I'm not short those few percentage points. Just wait for your share of the money. Okay, I'm hanging up."

"Happy New Year."

"Happy New Year."

Chen Guiliang returned to the classroom, and Xie Yang shouted, "You son of a... Hurry up and come over, the party's about to start!"

Gao Zhan leaned against the window, smoking, not really participating in the party.

His wife, Liu Shuying, said, "There are ten days until the final exams. Next semester, your studies will be even more intense, and you'll have fewer weekend breaks. Before the Gaokao, this will probably be the last party for our class..."

"Tonight, let's not talk about studying. Everyone have fun, and get back to reviewing tomorrow..."

Although his scores in the last two exams have dropped compared to before, he hasn't violated school rules again, and he's very attentive in class. He is also going to participate in the New Concept Composition Competition semifinal. Let's wish him the best of luck in achieving a good result!"

*Clap clap clap clap!*

A round of applause erupted, and the whole class looked at Chen Guiliang.

Except for Li Jun.

Liu Shuying called Chen Guiliang by his nickname with a smile, "Great Hero Chen, why don't you lead the way and perform something?"

"Huh?" Chen Guiliang was momentarily stunned.

Liu Shuying beckoned, "Come on over. You can sing a song, or if that's too much, recite a poem."

In his past life, although Chen Guiliang was often dragged to KTV by friends, he had always been hopelessly tone-deaf when singing.

Since he was going to make a fool of himself anyway, it didn't matter what he sang.

As the saying goes, as long as you're not embarrassed, the ones who are will be others.

Chen Guiliang walked to the cleared space where the desks had been. "Hello, teachers. Hello, classmates. I'll sing a song by Andy Lau, 'Thank You for Your Love'... um, the Sichuanese version."

There was no microphone, no background music. He just sang a cappella.

"Don't ask me, how many blades I've taken in my life. You don't know how deep my wounds are, ya."

"To cut open a wound is always so cruel, I advise you not to be that crazy person, ah. For now, just screw Liu Jifen, screw Liu Jifen, ya..."

The whole class listened, stunned, then burst into laughter.

Even Li Jun was banging on his desk laughing.

Bian Guanyue was laughing so hard she was doubled over her desk and couldn't sit up straight.

After the song, Chen Guiliang, his expression unchanged, bowed seriously and left the stage. "Thank you, thank you all for your support."

Liu Shuying didn't know whether to laugh or cry. "Very well sung. Quick, next performance."

There was a program for the party.

And some of the performances were of extremely high quality, like the current scene from Romeo and Juliet.

Class president Li Rui played Romeo, and top student Wu Meng played Juliet.

Both of them delivered their lines entirely in English, even with a London accent. They were full of emotion, their acting was explosive, and they put the little fresh-faced idols of later years to shame.

To be honest, the live effect was quite stunning, as if they were watching a professional stage play.

The whole class was awestruck!

There were only a few planned performances. Liu Shuying called on students randomly, interspersing impromptu acts.

The most ridiculous was Xu Haibo. When his name was called, he really didn't know what to sing, and in a moment of inspiration, he started singing the national anthem.

Li Yulin, however, was prepared. He had even brought his battered guitar and his performance of "You in My Lifetime" received enthusiastic applause.

"Bian Guanyue, why don't you perform something too," Liu Shuying said.

Bian Guanyue wasn't shy. She walked over and said, "Li Yulin, can I borrow your guitar?"

"Here." Li Yulin quickly offered it to her.

Chen Guiliang suddenly recalled a memory. In his past life, at this same New Year's party, Bian Guanyue had also been called on to sing.

But she was unwilling, sitting at her seat with a cold expression, making the atmosphere a bit awkward.

It was Teacher Gao Zhan who had smoothed things over by singing a Soviet folk song in Russian.

It had changed.

People and things had all changed.

Bian Guanyue walked confidently to the open space, and holding the guitar, she began to sing: "When I was little, a noisy and willful child. My grandmother, would always sing to lull me... The sky is dark, it's about to rain. The sky is dark... dark, dark..."

The sounds of private chatter disappeared. Everyone was listening quietly to Bian Guanyue sing.

In that moment, she seemed to be glowing.

Her vocal technique was professional, and her talent was immense. She was able to sing with a flavor slightly different from Stefanie Sun's.

Halfway through, Wu Meng couldn't help but whisper to Li Rui, "She's had vocal training."
